entries.query: FDA guidance "Clinical Trial Imaging Endpoint Process Standards" imaging charter software version image analysis
entries.notes: Located the April 2018 final guidance (docket FDA-2011-D-0586); HHS copy returned HTML, FDA media copy (fda.gov/media/81172/download) downloaded.

entries.query: https://www.fda.gov/media/81172/download (full text searched for software/version/upgrade)
entries.notes: Read: 'Software upgrades within the trial period may affect how images are generated. Changes in an image may be caused by these software changes and be incorrectly attributed to actual clinical changes. The charter should specify minimum requirements for important software'; ongoing site qualification to control hardware/software changes in quantitative imaging trials; the same computer-assisted interpretation tool should be available to all readers. Mainly acquisition/reconstruction software; no explicit same-analysis-version-at-both-timepoints rule.

entries.query: Coric Petzold Uitdehaag Balk "Software updates of OCT segmentation algorithms influence longitudinal assessment of retinal atrophy" pdf; https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10043994/1/Petzold%20Manuscript_rev_changes_in%20red_LB.pdf
entries.notes: Decisive: accepted manuscript read at methods/results level. 178 MS patients with 2-year follow-up: atrophy -0.95 um (all old version), -0.71 um (all new), -0.63 um when baseline segmented with old and follow-up with new; mixed vs all-old differed (0.32 um, p<0.001), mixed vs all-new did not (0.08 um, p=0.136). Authors: stored baseline 'retains its previous segmentation' after a device update, so baselines should be re-segmented with the same version. Closest prior work to the manuscript's question (OCT, single vendor update, no reference change, group means). The AAM contains an unresolved drafting note; published version not read (paywalled).
